scripts.cli: DIR=workspaces/cli/app-$(( $(ls -d workspaces/cli/app-* 2>/dev/null | sed 's/.*app-//' | sort -n | tail -1) + 1 )) && mkdir -p "$DIR" && cd "$DIR" && claude --plugin-dir ../../../kova-plugin
scripts.clean: mv workspaces workspaces_trash_$$ 2>/dev/null; mkdir -p workspaces/cli workspaces/sdk && rm -rf workspaces_trash_* &
